newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ECONMIN TIGHT-LIPPED ON 97 BUDGET.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ECONMIN TIGHT-LIPPED ON 97 BUDGET.

text.p: Prime Minister Costas Simitis was brought up to date on the drafting of Greece's 1997 central government budget at a meeting today, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou said.
He declined to make any other statement on the draft budget but said it would be sent to government bodies for approval soon. The budget must be submitted to parliament by the end of this month.

Among those at the meeting were Simitis, Papandoniou, Deputy Finance Ministers Nick Chrystodoulakis and George Drys and Deputy National Economy Minister Christos Pachtas and central bank governor Lukas Papademos. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
